title: Causal-Tune: Mining Causal Factors from Vision Foundation Models for Domain Generalized Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: PEFT that keeps VFM feature components linked to causal factors and suppresses spurious ones (details unverified).
adaptation: E1 failures come from spurious cues (scuff streaks, half-cut layout); one arm on VFM-H in place of Rein.
min_experiment: Arm: VFM-H + Causal-Tune. Baseline: VFM-H + Rein. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2. Kill: not +0.02.
